WorkloadReview.IndependentUnit: one fixed-t numeric J-IBP evaluation; later one original bottom-up DE setting
WorkloadReview.DependencyEvidence: Anchor first verifies runtime and builds private native executables and AB kernels; numerical points genuinely require these artifacts. run_case -> cold_anchor -> collect_points: dynamically dispatch every point in the current requested batch. Next batch is needed only when rational coefficients remain unknown. run_case production requires a complete anchor and invokes original learn_anchor/prepare_setting/solve_de, preserving real lower-sector dependencies. Separate jobs release the parallel allocation before serial algebra begins. Production must only be submitted after the complete anchor receipt. Actual dispatcher regression tests early slot release and exactly-once reuse.

IndependentBranches.Evidence: Initial96 point workers read immutable assets, have disjoint locked outputs, and never read one another.
IndependentBranches.CapacityEvidence: 48 single-core workers;98304MiB worst-case sum below131072MiB, leaving32768MiB coordinator headroom. Actual test_collect_dispatch regression passed.
